title: Rapidgzip: Parallel Decompression and Seeking in Gzip Files Using Cache Prefetching
relevance: Primary source. Introduces cache-prefetch architecture for parallel gzip decompression of arbitrary files, generalizing pugz.

title: Parallel Decompression of Gzip-Compressed Files and Random Access to DNA Sequences (pugz)
relevance: Predecessor to rapidgzip. First parallel gzip decompressor using speculative synchronization, limited to ASCII text.

title: tigz: Parallel gzip decompression and compression using libdeflate and rapidgzip
relevance: Practical tool combining libdeflate compression with rapidgzip-based parallel decompression.

title: pigz: Parallel Implementation of gzip
relevance: Widely-used parallel gzip that parallelizes compression (block-level) but uses sequential decompression. Baseline for comparison.
